messages:
Anna K.: quick question — can we toggle the new dims-aware routing in console for a soft canary?
Mike R.: we talked about a flag, but need telemetry first. what signals do we care about?
Anna K.: success rate, mean tail p95 token latency, and a new metric: inferred_vs_declared_dims (counts where client omitted header)
Sophia L.: +1 on inferred_vs_declared. also need to expose estimated_units in the UI per-request so product sees cost impact for mixed-dim payloads
Mike R.: estimated_units is doable if preflight runs in the ingress. but preflight adds ~6ms median; is that acceptable for low-latency SLAs?
Julian T.: suggestion: run preflight in fast async mode that returns an immediate unit-estimate via header exchange then continues normal path. header example: `X-Embed-Estimate: units=12; dims=1536; inferred=false`
Anna K.: love the header approach. fallback policy: if no header, runtime infers dims from first vector and marks `inferred=true` in telemetry + console badge
Mike R.: concern: some SDKs batch heterogeneous dims in one request (we've seen this). What should router do? split into sub-requests or fastfail?
Sophia L.: propose split-by-dim with cost attribution and a console trace that links sub-requests together. default to split, but provide per-tenant toggle to fastfail for strict clients
Anna K.: UX asks: console should surface any automatic splits and show latency/cost delta. maybe a small inline timeline and a toggle: "auto-split ON (recommended)"
Julian T.: impl note: add routing tag `route.dim.policy=split|fail|coerce` to telemetry. that gives us breakouts in dashboards quickly
julian-bot: deploybot: canary feature flag `dims_routing_split_v1` created for 5% tenants (rollout_id=ff-382)`
Mike R.: ops question — how do we chart inferred=true noise? We need a filter in dashboards to exclude inferred-only traffic when evaluating accuracy regressions
Sophia L.: agreed. add `client_declared=true/false` dimension and default dashboard view to declared-only for quality evals, but keep an "all traffic" view for cost analysis
Anna K.: action items: 1) runtime: add `X-Embed-Estimate` header + inferred flag in telemetry (Julian) 2) console: show auto-split trace + estimated_units in request flyout (Console Team) 3) SDK docs: recommend per-request header (Mike) 4) canary: enable `dims_routing_split_v1` for 5% (ops)
Mike R.: I'll own SDK docs + telemetry dashboard filter. planning PR by EOD tomorrow.
Console Team: we'll prototype the request flyout UI with a compact "split map" and a cost delta. demo Thurs. :eyes:
Anna K.: thanks all — marking this thread resolved for the initial rollout. please ping if you hit a blocking regression
